repository_state.reason: Lot 5.5 is maintainer validated on 2026-08-14 after closure of all P1/P2/P3 findings. Its 61-case PostgreSQL recipe, security checks and Lot 5.4 non-regression are validated. Lot 5.6 implementation remains unauthorized.

working_lot.name: Providers and API synchronization core
scope: Providers administration and provider detail pages
Provider adapters and adapter-specific configuration forms
Encrypted provider secrets with key_version
Real OCBlackTop and TheSportsDB championship discovery without event synchronization
Manual provider championship source configuration even without discovery
Persistent unassociated provider discoveries requiring manual association or explicit championship creation
Per-championship adapter-specific source configuration supporting different endpoints and strategies within the same provider
Manual adoption of rediscovered source configuration divergences
Periodic discovery model: enabled/disabled, 30-day default, 7-day minimum, execution wired to scheduler in 5.4
Persistent scheduler with current/historical streams, recent catchup and deep-history classes
Sliding current window, seven days by default and configurable
Weighted global scheduling current/recent/deep at 3/2/1 by default
Persistent leases, heartbeat, fencing tokens and crash recovery
Global worker pool and provider concurrency limits shared with discovery
Hybrid multi-window quota and pacing engine authorized for 5.5
Historical backfill across all available seasons
Preservation of local corrections
Public API suppression and synchronization stop when a championship is disabled without deleting data
Structured synchronization history and rotating technical logs
Local championship logo upload
mandatory_constraints: Newly discovered championships never create a local championship automatically
Manual championship source configuration remains available even when discovery is unavailable
Newly discovered championships are never synchronized automatically before explicit later activation
A rediscovery never overwrites an approved source configuration automatically
WRC remains an OCBlackTop championship and not a separate provider adapter
One provider is principal for a championship in V1 while alternative sources may remain inactive
Current synchronization uses a sliding window rather than restarting at January 1
No worker may commit or fail with an expired or superseded lease fencing token
Cursor advancement and corresponding durable result are atomic
Sync-now is a temporary priority boost and never bypasses quotas, reserve, backoff, leases or concurrency
Disabling a championship removes it from the public API and stops synchronization while retaining all stored data and cursors
Quota unknown in 5.5 means conservative operation with local accounting and adapter minimum interval, not an automatic total block
Only current work may consume the protected quota reserve
All real outbound requests share the provider budget and are conservatively counted once sent
No complete provider Event ingestion is implemented in 5.5
Provider secrets are never returned after storage and never logged
